## Objective

Phase 1 of `planning/gfw_analysis_plan.qmd`: recompute the data-structure
findings at render time, and test the assumptions the later phases rest on.
It reads the Phase 0 outputs (`05_prepare_analysis.qmd`), the Primary
records, and the vessel crosswalk.

| Step | Question |
|---|---|
| 1 | Composition: hours, records and vessels by gear × stage (× season) |
| 2 | Distribution: zeros, dispersion, skew, Tweedie power |
| 3 | Transforms: does `y_vst` stabilise variance and limit influential cells? |
| 4 | Time series by distance band, with trend and season decomposed |
| 5 | Vessel concentration, and the pre-window screen of charter and survey hulls |
| 6 | Depth and effort: gear niches, collinearity with lease distance |
| 7 | Is AIS uptake spatially uniform before construction? (key BAG assumption) |
| 8 | Maps |
| 9 | Temporal completeness: which model time steps the data support |
| 10 | Construction exposure and event time: how many cells each project's foundations and cable works reach, and effort by band around each project's first foundation |

Figures and tables go to `reports/explore/` (gitignored: derived GFW
products), listed with their hashes in `reports/explore/manifest.csv` and its
provenance sidecar. **The gate** at the end gathers the three decisions this
phase feeds: the transform per dataset × gear (step 3), hulls to send back to
`03` (step 5), and whether the BAG needs a pre-trend term (step 7).

## Libraries and shared code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(terra)

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/vessel_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")

# Quarto parameters (header); `params` is read-only while rendering. Run chunk
# by chunk, `params` is missing or left over from another session, so the
# header is read from this file directly instead
qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(file.path(root, "r/06_explore.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
paths <- gfw_paths_with(qparams)

set.seed(42) # workflow-wide seed (plan, FAIR)

datasets <- c("vp", "afe")
ds_label <- c(vp = "VP", afe = "AFE")
stage_breaks <- dev_stages$start[-1] # 2020-10-01 and 2023-04-01

fig_dir <- file.path(paths$explore, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(paths$explore, "tables")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# every output is recorded here; the manifest is written at the end
outputs <- character()
save_tab <- function(df, name) {
  f <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".csv"))
  write_csv(df, f, na = "")
  outputs <<- c(outputs, f)
  invisible(df)
}
save_fig <- function(p, name, width = 10, height = 6) {
  f <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png"))
  ggsave(f, p, width = width, height = min(height, 49), dpi = 120, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
  outputs <<- c(outputs, f)
  invisible(p)
}

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10))
```

## Read the Phase 0 outputs and the records

```{r}
table_path <- \(ds, ts) file.path(paths$analysis, sprintf("%s_%s_gear.csv", ds, ts))
time_steps <- c("stage", "stage_season", "season_year", "month")

read_analysis <- function(ds, ts) {
  read_csv(table_path(ds, ts), col_types = cols(
    cell_id = "c", gear_class = "c", stage = "c", season = "c", aoi_class = "c",
    dist_band = "c", nearest_project = "c", domain = "l", phase = "c", .default = "?")) |>
    mutate(gear_class = factor(gear_class, levels = analysis_gears),
           dist_band  = factor(dist_band, levels = dist_band_levels))
}

tabs <- map(set_names(datasets), \(ds) map(set_names(time_steps), \(ts) read_analysis(ds, ts)))

cells <- st_read(file.path(paths$analysis, "cells.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(dist_band = factor(dist_band, levels = dist_band_levels))
weights <- readRDS(file.path(paths$analysis, "grid_weights.rds"))
stopifnot("weights and cells.gpkg are in a different cell order" =
            identical(weights$cell_id, cells$cell_id))
lw_W <- weights$lw_W

cell_lease <- st_drop_geometry(cells) |>
  transmute(cell_id, dist_band, in_lease = dist_lease_km < 0)

records_path <- \(ds) file.path(paths$processed_gfw, sprintf("gfw_%s_id_classified.csv", ds))
records <- map_dfr(set_names(datasets), \(ds)
  read_csv(records_path(ds), col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
    filter(in_primary == "TRUE") |>
    transmute(MMSI, vessel_name = `Vessel Name`, cell_id, gear_class,
              date = as.Date(date), hours = as.numeric(hours)), .id = "dataset") |>
  mutate(year_month = floor_date(date, "month"),
         stage = stage_of(year_month), season = season_of(year_month),
         year = year(date), gear_class = factor(gear_class, levels = analysis_gears)) |>
  left_join(cell_lease, by = "cell_id")

stopifnot("records outside the analysis gears or cells" =
            !anyNA(records$gear_class) && !anyNA(records$dist_band))

# hours must match the Phase 0 tables (which 05 reconciled with 04)
rec_check <- records |> count(dataset, wt = hours, name = "records") |>
  left_join(map_dfr(tabs, \(d) tibble(tables = sum(d$stage$hours)), .id = "dataset"), by = "dataset")
rec_check
stopifnot("records and Phase 0 tables disagree" = isTRUE(all.equal(rec_check$records, rec_check$tables)))

# Ørsted infrastructure (05, step 8): foundations and cable routes, and the
# per cell × month exposure covariates
foundations <- st_read(paths$infra, layer = "foundations", quiet = TRUE)
cables <- st_read(paths$infra, layer = "cables", quiet = TRUE)
infra_month <- read_csv(file.path(paths$analysis, "infra_cell_month.csv"),
                        col_types = cols(cell_id = "c", phase = "c", .default = "?"))

# each project's foundation window (first to last dated foundation), for the
# time-series shading and the event-time origin
found_windows <- st_drop_geometry(foundations) |>
  filter(status == "installed") |>
  group_by(project) |>
  summarise(first_found = min(foundation_installed), last_found = max(foundation_end),
            .groups = "drop")
found_windows

input_files <- c(map(datasets, \(ds) table_path(ds, time_steps)) |> unlist(),
                 file.path(paths$analysis, c("cells.gpkg", "grid_weights.rds", "infra_cell_month.csv")),
                 records_path(datasets), paths$crosswalk,
                 file.path(paths$interim_gfw, "gfw_vp_id_cell_month.csv"),
```

## Step 1: composition

Hours, records and distinct MMSIs by dataset × gear × stage, with three
rates: raw (`hours / months`), season-standardised (the sum of the cells'
`rate_std`, caveat 8) and per vessel-month (`rate_fleet`, caveat 5). Read the
raw and standardised rates together for level comparisons, and the
per-vessel rate against the raw one: a raw rate that rises while the
per-vessel rate stays flat is fleet coverage, not more fishing per vessel.

```{r}
months_of <- map_dfr(tabs, \(d) distinct(d$stage, stage, months), .id = "dataset") |> distinct(stage, months)
months_ss <- distinct(tabs$vp$stage_season, stage, season, months)

rate_std_aoi <- map_dfr(tabs, \(d) d$stage |> group_by(gear_class, stage) |>
  summarise(rate_std = sum(rate_std), .groups = "drop"), .id = "dataset")

composition <- records |>
  group_by(dataset, gear_class, stage) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), records = n(), n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(months_of, by = "stage") |>
  left_join(rate_std_aoi, by = c("dataset", "gear_class", "stage")) |>
  mutate(rate = hours / months,
         std_vs_raw_pct = 100 * (rate / rate_std - 1),
         rate_fleet = hours / (months * n_mmsi))

composition |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2))) |> knitr::kable()
save_tab(composition, "composition_stage")

composition_ss <- records |>
  group_by(dataset, gear_class, stage, season) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), records = n(), n_mmsi = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(months_ss, by = c("stage", "season")) |>
  mutate(rate = hours / months, rate_fleet = hours / (months * n_mmsi))
save_tab(composition_ss, "composition_stage_season")

composition_ss |>
  select(dataset, gear_class, stage, season, rate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(stage, season), values_from = rate) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 1))) |> knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
p <- composition |>
  pivot_longer(c(rate, rate_std, rate_fleet), names_to = "measure") |>
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, c("rate", "rate_std", "rate_fleet"),
                          c("hours / month", "season-standardised", "hours / vessel-month"))) |>

  geom_line() + geom_point() +
```

## Step 2: distribution diagnostics

Per surface (dataset × gear × stratum) at every time step: percent zero,
mean, variance, var/mean, skewness (type 2), and quantiles of the positive
values. The Tweedie power is the slope of log variance on log mean across
cells, from each cell's 128 monthly values. A profile-likelihood estimate
needs `glmmTMB`, which is installed at Phase 5; it is deferred to there.

```{r}
surface_keys <- list(stage = "stage", stage_season = c("stage", "season"),
                     season_year = c("season", "season_year"), month = "year_month")

dist_diag <- function(t, keys) {
  t |> group_by(gear_class, across(all_of(keys))) |>
    summarise(n_cells = n(), pct_zero = 100 * mean(hours == 0),
              mean = mean(hours), var = var(hours), var_mean = var / mean,
              skew = e1071::skewness(hours, type = 2),
              q50_pos = quantile(hours[hours > 0], 0.5, names = FALSE),
              q90_pos = quantile(hours[hours > 0], 0.9, names = FALSE),
              q99_pos = quantile(hours[hours > 0], 0.99, names = FALSE),
              max = max(hours), .groups = "drop")
}

distribution <- map_dfr(set_names(datasets), \(ds) map_dfr(set_names(time_steps), \(ts)
  dist_diag(tabs[[ds]][[ts]], surface_keys[[ts]]) |>
    mutate(across(any_of(c("season_year", "year_month")), as.character)), .id = "time_step"),
  .id = "dataset")
save_tab(distribution, "distribution_by_surface")

# the stage surfaces, as in the plan's "Cell × stage × gear" table
distribution |> filter(time_step == "stage") |>
  select(dataset, gear_class, stage, pct_zero, var_mean, skew, q50_pos, q90_pos, q99_pos) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 1))) |> knitr::kable()

# every time step, summarised across its surfaces
distribution |>
  group_by(dataset, gear_class, time_step) |>
  summarise(surfaces = n(), median_pct_zero = median(pct_zero),
            median_var_mean = median(var_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(time_step = factor(time_step, time_steps)) |> arrange(dataset, gear_class, time_step) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 1))) |> knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
tweedie_power <- map_dfr(tabs, \(d) d$month |>
  group_by(gear_class, cell_id) |>
  summarise(m = mean(hours), v = var(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(gear_class) |>
  summarise(power_monthly = mv_slope(m, v), cells_used = sum(m > 0 & v > 0), .groups = "drop"),
  .id = "dataset")
tweedie_power |> mutate(power_monthly = round(power_monthly, 2)) |> knitr::kable()
save_tab(tweedie_power, "tweedie_power")

vp_integer <- all(abs(tabs$vp$month$hours - round(tabs$vp$month$hours)) < 1e-9)
vp_integer
```

## Step 3: transform check

Three scales per surface: raw density, √density and log(density + *c*),
with *c* half the smallest positive density in the surface. `y_vst` is √ for
VP and log for AFE (05), so it is always one of the three and is labelled as
such. The transforms serve only the spatial statistics, so the measures are
variance stabilisation and influence, not normality, and every plot uses the
**positive values only**, with the zero share printed on each panel.

Per surface and scale:

- `skew`: skewness of the positive transformed values;
- `mv_slope`: slope of log(variance of the transformed monthly densities) on
  log(mean raw monthly density) across cells, within the surface's stratum.
  Near 0 means the transform stabilises the variance. On the raw scale it is
  the Tweedie power. For log, *c* comes from the stratum's monthly values;
- `lev_share`: share of cells flagged influential in the Moran scatterplot
  (`spdep::moran.plot` with `lw_W`; its hat-value / Cook's-distance measures).

The plan's layout (rows gear × stratum, columns the scales) is used for the
stage and stage × season pages. At season-year it would be 66 rows per page,
so season-year contributes numbers only (to the decision rule and a
trajectory plot).

```{r}
scales_all <- c("raw", "sqrt", "log")
vst_scale  <- c(vp = "sqrt", afe = "log")
alt_scale  <- c(vp = "log", afe = "sqrt")
scale_lab  <- \(ds) c(raw = "raw density", sqrt = "√ density", log = "log(density + c)") |>
  (\(l) { l[vst_scale[[ds]]] <- paste(l[vst_scale[[ds]]], "(y_vst)"); l })()

# one surface: values in cells order, for the Moran scatterplot
surface_check <- function(sdat, mdat, keep_moran) {
  d <- sdat$density[match(cells$cell_id, sdat$cell_id)]
  pos <- d > 0
  # per-cell mean raw monthly density, shared by the three scales
  m_cell <- mdat |> group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(m = mean(density), .groups = "drop")
  res <- map(set_names(scales_all), function(sc) {
    v <- transform_scale(d, sc)
    v_cell <- mdat |> mutate(v = transform_scale(density, sc)) |>
      group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(vv = var(v), .groups = "drop")
    mp <- if (sum(pos) > 1 && var(v) > 0) moran.plot(v, lw_W, plot = FALSE, return_df = TRUE) else NULL
    list(stats = tibble(scale = sc, n_pos = sum(pos), pct_zero = 100 * mean(!pos),
                        skew = if (sum(pos) > 2) e1071::skewness(v[pos], type = 2) else NA_real_,
                        mv_slope = mv_slope(m_cell$m, v_cell$vv[match(m_cell$cell_id, v_cell$cell_id)]),
                        lev_share = if (is.null(mp)) NA_real_ else mean(mp$is_inf)),
         moran = if (keep_moran && !is.null(mp)) tibble(scale = sc, x = mp$x, wx = mp$wx, is_inf = mp$is_inf) else NULL)
  })
  list(stats = map_dfr(res, "stats"), moran = map_dfr(res, "moran"))
}

transform_checks <- list()
moran_data <- list()
for (ds in datasets) for (ts in c("stage", "stage_season", "season_year")) {
  keys <- surface_keys[[ts]]
  s_nest <- tabs[[ds]][[ts]] |> select(cell_id, gear_class, all_of(keys), density) |>
    nest(sdat = c(cell_id, density))
  m_nest <- tabs[[ds]]$month |> select(cell_id, gear_class, all_of(keys), density) |>
    nest(mdat = c(cell_id, density))
  both <- inner_join(s_nest, m_nest, by = c("gear_class", keys))
  stopifnot("surfaces without monthly data" = nrow(both) == nrow(s_nest))
  out <- map2(both$sdat, both$mdat, surface_check, keep_moran = ts != "season_year")
  meta <- select(both, gear_class, all_of(keys))
  transform_checks[[paste(ds, ts)]] <- bind_cols(meta[rep(seq_len(nrow(meta)), each = 3), ],
                                                 map_dfr(out, "stats")) |>
    mutate(dataset = ds, time_step = ts, .before = 1)
  moran_data[[paste(ds, ts)]] <- map2_dfr(seq_along(out), out, \(i, o)
    if (nrow(o$moran)) bind_cols(meta[i, ], o$moran) else NULL)
}

transform_check <- bind_rows(map(transform_checks, \(t) mutate(t, across(any_of("season_year"), as.character))))
for (ds in datasets) save_tab(filter(transform_check, dataset == ds), paste0("transform_check_", ds))

transform_check |>
  group_by(dataset, gear_class, scale) |>
  summarise(surfaces = n(), median_skew = median(skew, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_mv_slope = median(mv_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_lev_share = median(lev_share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> knitr::kable()
```

### Decision rule

Keep `y_vst` (√ for VP, log for AFE) unless, on the median surface of a
dataset × gear across all three descriptive time steps, the alternative has
a mean–variance slope at least 0.2 closer to zero **and** a high-leverage
share at least a third lower.

```{r}
medians <- transform_check |>
  group_by(dataset, gear_class, scale) |>
  summarise(mv = median(abs(mv_slope), na.rm = TRUE),
            lev = median(lev_share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

transform_decision <- map_dfr(datasets, \(ds) {
  cur <- filter(medians, dataset == ds, scale == vst_scale[[ds]])
  alt <- filter(medians, dataset == ds, scale == alt_scale[[ds]])
  inner_join(cur, alt, by = c("dataset", "gear_class"), suffix = c("_cur", "_alt")) |>
    mutate(slope_gain = mv_cur - mv_alt,
           lev_drop = 1 - lev_alt / lev_cur,
           switch = slope_gain >= 0.2 & lev_drop >= 1 / 3,
           transform = if_else(switch, scale_alt, scale_cur))
})
transform_decision |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> knitr::kable()
save_tab(transform_decision, "transform_decision")
```

### Transform-check figures

```{r}
# rows: gear × stratum label; columns: scale
surface_label <- function(t, keys) {
  t |> unite("surface", gear_class, all_of(keys), sep = " · ", remove = FALSE)
}

for (ds in datasets) for (ts in c("stage", "stage_season")) {
  keys <- surface_keys[[ts]]
  labs_sc <- scale_lab(ds)
  pos <- tabs[[ds]][[ts]] |> filter(density > 0) |>
    select(cell_id, gear_class, all_of(keys), density, depth_m, dist_lease_km, bpi_broad) |>
    group_by(gear_class, across(all_of(keys))) |>
    mutate(raw = density, sqrt = sqrt(density), log = log(density + min(density) / 2)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(scales_all), names_to = "scale", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(scale = factor(scale, scales_all, labs_sc)) |>
    surface_label(keys)
  zeros <- transform_check |> filter(dataset == ds, time_step == ts, scale == "raw") |>
    surface_label(keys) |> select(surface, pct_zero) |>
    crossing(scale = factor(labs_sc, labs_sc)) |>
    mutate(lab = sprintf("%.0f%% zero", pct_zero))
  n_rows <- n_distinct(pos$surface)
  h <- 1.3 * n_rows + 1.5
  tag <- sprintf("%s · %s", ds_label[[ds]], ts)

  save_fig(ggplot(pos, aes(value)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey40") +
             geom_text(data = zeros, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
             facet_grid(surface ~ scale, scales = "free") +
             theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
             labs(x = NULL, y = "cells", title = paste("Positive values by scale:", tag)),
           sprintf("transform_hist_%s_%s", ds, ts), height = h)

  save_fig(ggplot(pos, aes(sample = value)) + stat_qq(size = 0.4) + stat_qq_line(colour = "red") +
             geom_text(data = zeros, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                       hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
             facet_grid(surface ~ scale, scales = "free") +
             theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
             labs(x = "normal quantile", y = NULL, title = paste("QQ plots of positive values (supporting only):", tag)),
           sprintf("transform_qq_%s_%s", ds, ts), height = h)

  # mean–variance: per cell, monthly values within the stratum
  mv <- tabs[[ds]]$month |> select(cell_id, gear_class, all_of(keys), density) |>
    group_by(gear_class, across(all_of(keys))) |>
    mutate(raw = density, sqrt = sqrt(density),
           log = if (any(density > 0)) log(density + min(density[density > 0]) / 2) else NA_real_) |>
    group_by(gear_class, across(all_of(keys)), cell_id) |>
    summarise(m = mean(density), across(all_of(scales_all), var), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(m > 0) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(scales_all), names_to = "scale", values_to = "v") |>
    filter(v > 0) |>
    mutate(scale = factor(scale, scales_all, labs_sc)) |>
    surface_label(keys)
  save_fig(ggplot(mv, aes(m, v)) + geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
             geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
             scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
             facet_grid(surface ~ scale, scales = "free_y") +
             theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
             labs(x = "mean raw monthly density (log)", y = "variance on the scale (log)",
                  title = paste("Mean–variance across cells; a flat line is stabilised:", tag)),
           sprintf("transform_meanvar_%s_%s", ds, ts), height = h)

  # Moran scatterplots, raw vs y_vst
  md <- moran_data[[paste(ds, ts)]] |> filter(scale %in% c("raw", vst_scale[[ds]])) |>
    mutate(scale = factor(scale, scales_all, labs_sc)) |> surface_label(keys)
  save_fig(ggplot(md, aes(x, wx)) +
             geom_point(aes(colour = is_inf), size = 0.4) +
             geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
             scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey60", `TRUE` = "red"), labels = c("", "influential")) +
             facet_grid(surface ~ scale, scales = "free") +
             theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
             labs(x = "value", y = "spatial lag", colour = NULL,
                  title = paste("Moran scatterplots, raw vs y_vst:", tag)),
           sprintf("transform_moran_%s_%s", ds, ts), height = h)

  # relationships with the static covariates (stage surfaces only)
  if (ts == "stage") {
    rel <- pos |> pivot_longer(c(depth_m, dist_lease_km, bpi_broad), names_to = "covariate", values_to = "cov")
    save_fig(ggplot(rel, aes(cov, value, colour = stage)) +
               geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.2) +
               geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
               facet_grid(gear_class + covariate ~ scale, scales = "free") +
               theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +

                    title = paste("Positive density against depth, lease distance and BPI:", ds_label[[ds]])),
             sprintf("transform_relationships_%s", ds), height = 18)
  }
}
```

### Pre-window screen

For every hull with a charter or survey window in the crosswalk
(`activity_excluded`), the share of its Primary hours inside the leases in
the 12 months before its first window, against the rest of the Primary fleet
in the same 12 months. Hulls above **twice** the fleet share are flagged, as
PROVIDER would have been before its window moved (caveat 11). A share on a
handful of hours is noise, so a hull needs at least **20 pre-window hours**
in the dataset to be flagged (decision 2026-10-19: the first render flagged
Cailyn & Maren, 338389953, on 5 VP hours, 2 of them in the leases; no action
was taken on it).

```{r}
min_flag_hours <- 20 # pre-window hours a hull needs before its share can flag it

windows <- read_chr(paths$crosswalk) |>
  filter(activity_excluded == "TRUE", !is.na(valid_from)) |>
  group_by(MMSI) |>
  summarise(vessel_name = first(Vessel_Name), operation = first(Operation),
            first_window = min(as.Date(valid_from)), .groups = "drop")

pre_window <- windows |>
  crossing(dataset = datasets) |>
  pmap_dfr(function(MMSI, vessel_name, operation, first_window, dataset) {
    win <- records[records$dataset == dataset &
                     records$date >= first_window - 365 & records$date < first_window, ]
    hull  <- win[win$MMSI == MMSI, ]
    fleet <- win[win$MMSI != MMSI, ]
    tibble(dataset, MMSI, vessel_name, operation, first_window,
           hull_hours = sum(hull$hours),
           hull_lease_share = if (nrow(hull)) sum(hull$hours[hull$in_lease]) / sum(hull$hours) else NA_real_,
           fleet_lease_share = sum(fleet$hours[fleet$in_lease]) / sum(fleet$hours))
  }) |>
  mutate(ratio = hull_lease_share / fleet_lease_share,
         flag = !is.na(ratio) & ratio > 2 & hull_hours >= min_flag_hours) |>
  arrange(desc(flag), desc(ratio))
save_tab(pre_window, "pre_window_screen")

pre_window |> filter(hull_hours > 0) |>
  mutate(across(c(hull_lease_share, fleet_lease_share), \(x) round(100 * x, 1)),
         across(c(hull_hours, ratio), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
# gear-depth niches: hours-weighted depth quantiles, Stage 1 baseline
wq <- function(x, w, p) { o <- order(x); cw <- cumsum(w[o]) / sum(w); x[o][which(cw >= p)[1]] }
niche <- map_dfr(tabs, \(d) d$stage, .id = "dataset") |>
  filter(stage == "Stage 1", hours > 0) |>

            depth_q75 = wq(depth_m, hours, 0.75), bpi_q50 = wq(bpi_broad, hours, 0.5),
            .groups = "drop")

round(covariate_rho, 2)
```

## Step 7: is AIS uptake spatially uniform?

The within-AOI BAG cancels an AOI-wide uptake trend only if uptake rises
**in parallel across the distance bands** before construction. Three
indicators per band and calendar year, restricted to the pre-construction
years with all 12 months (2016–2022; Stage 2 runs to March 2023):

- distinct Primary MMSIs per gear;
- Primary VP hours per gear;
- all-vessel raw VP hours (`gfw_vp_id_cell_month.csv`, every vessel type).

Test: a quasi-Poisson GLM of each indicator on `band + year` against
`band × year`, by F test. A significant interaction means the bands do not
trend in parallel.

**Reading the result (decision 2026-10-19).** With 35 band-years per test
and large year-to-year variation, a non-significant interaction is weak
evidence of parallel trends, not proof. The **raw all-vessel series is not
an uptake measure**: inside the leases it rises several-fold to a 2019–2020
peak and falls back in 2021, while the other bands roughly double. That
pattern is pre-construction project traffic (site surveys), not AIS
adoption. The BAG therefore proceeds within the AOI as planned, and a
`band × year` pre-trend term is added for every gear as a **Phase 8
sensitivity run**, whatever these tests say.

```{r}
years_pre <- 2016:2022

mmsi_band <- records |> filter(year %in% years_pre) |>
  group_by(dataset, gear_class, dist_band, year) |>
  summarise(value = n_distinct(MMSI), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(indicator = paste(ds_label[dataset], "MMSIs")) |>
  complete(nesting(dataset, gear_class, indicator), dist_band, year = years_pre, fill = list(value = 0))

vp_band <- records |> filter(dataset == "vp", year %in% years_pre) |>
  group_by(gear_class, dist_band, year) |>
  summarise(value = sum(hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(dataset = "vp", indicator = "VP hours")

raw_vp <- read_csv(file.path(paths$interim_gfw, "gfw_vp_id_cell_month.csv"),
                   col_types = cols(cell_id = "c", .default = "?")) |>
  mutate(year = year(`Year Month`)) |>
  filter(year %in% years_pre) |>
  left_join(cell_lease, by = "cell_id") |>
  group_by(dist_band, year) |>
  summarise(value = sum(vp_hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(dataset = "vp", gear_class = factor("ALL VESSELS"), indicator = "raw VP hours (all vessels)")

uptake <- bind_rows(mmsi_band, vp_band, raw_vp) |>
  mutate(gear_class = as.character(gear_class))
save_tab(uptake, "uptake_by_band")

p <- uptake |>
  group_by(indicator, gear_class, dist_band) |>
  # indexed to each band's own 2016–2022 mean, not to 2016: sparse series
  # (e.g. fixed AFE) have bands with no vessels in 2016, where a 2016 base
  # divides by zero
  mutate(index = value / mean(value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(year, index, colour = dist_band)) + geom_line() + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ indicator + gear_class, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "index (band's 2016–2022 mean = 1, log)", colour = "band (km)",
       title = "Pre-construction trends by distance band (2016–2022); parallel lines = uniform uptake")
save_fig(p, "uptake_by_band", height = 10)
p

uptake_test <- uptake |>
  group_by(indicator, gear_class) |>
  group_modify(\(d, k) {
    d <- mutate(d, year_c = year - 2019)
    m0 <- glm(value ~ dist_band + year_c, family = quasipoisson, data = d)
    m1 <- glm(value ~ dist_band * year_c, family = quasipoisson, data = d)
    a <- anova(m0, m1, test = "F")
    # per-band annual growth, for reading the size of any divergence
    slopes <- coef(m1)[c("year_c", grep("^dist_band.*:year_c$", names(coef(m1)), value = TRUE))]
    growth <- exp(slopes[1] + c(0, slopes[-1])) - 1
    tibble(F = a$F[2], p = a$`Pr(>F)`[2],
           growth_min_pct = 100 * min(growth), growth_max_pct = 100 * max(growth))
  }) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(parallel = p >= 0.05)
uptake_test |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |> knitr::kable()
save_tab(uptake_test, "uptake_parallel_test")
```

## Step 8: maps

Density per gear × stage and per gear × stage × season on one colour scale
per gear and dataset (√-stretched), with the lease outlines; the n_MMSI per
cell; and differences between stages on the season-standardised rates
(caveat 8).

Every map draws three layers of the grid so that "no effort" and "not in the
grid" cannot be confused:

- **pale grey:** grid cells with 0 h (or no change, on the difference maps);
- **colour:** cells with effort, on the scale;
- **thin dark grey line:** the grid's outer boundary. Outside it is basemap
  only (cells GFW returned no records for, excluded in 02).

The lease outlines are drawn as a black line over a white halo, so they stay
visible over both the darkest and lightest colours of every scale. The
foundation positions go on top (05, step 8): filled for those installed by
August 2026, hollow for SRW's 40 planned positions. They are drawn on every
stage panel, including Stages 1–2 before any were built, as a fixed
reference for where the structures stand.

```{r}
basemap <- rast(paths$basemap) |> aggregate(fact = 3)
bm_arr <- as.array(basemap)
bm_max <- max(bm_arr, na.rm = TRUE)
bm_ras <- as.raster(array(pmin(1, pmax(0, coalesce(c(bm_arr), bm_max) / bm_max)), dim(bm_arr)))
bm_ext <- as.vector(ext(basemap))
bm_layer <- annotation_raster(bm_ras, bm_ext["xmin"], bm_ext["xmax"], bm_ext["ymin"], bm_ext["ymax"])

leases <- map_dfr(paths$leases, \(f) st_read(f, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(cells)) |> summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)))
cells_geo <- select(cells, cell_id)
bb <- st_bbox(cells)
# outer boundary of the grid, so cells outside it read as "not in the grid"
grid_outline <- st_union(st_geometry(cells)) |> st_boundary()

zero_fill <- "grey85" # cells in the grid with no effort

# layers under the data: basemap, then every grid cell in pale grey; cells
# with effort are drawn over the grey, zero cells (NA fill) let it show
map_under <- function() {
  list(bm_layer,
       geom_sf(data = cells_geo, fill = zero_fill, colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE))
}

# layers over the data: grid boundary, the leases as a black line on a wider
# white halo (visible on dark and light fills alike), then the foundations
# as small white-ringed dots, filled if installed and hollow if planned
found_inst <- filter(foundations, status == "installed")
found_plan <- filter(foundations, status == "planned")
map_over <- function(zero_note = "grid cells with 0 h") {
  list(geom_sf(data = grid_outline, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE),
       geom_sf(data = leases, fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 1.4, inherit.aes = FALSE),
       geom_sf(data = leases, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE),
       geom_sf(data = found_plan, shape = 21, fill = NA, colour = "black", size = 0.6,
               stroke = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE),
       geom_sf(data = found_inst, shape = 21, fill = "black", colour = "white", size = 0.8,
               stroke = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE),
       coord_sf(xlim = bb[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bb[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = FALSE, datum = NA),
       labs(caption = paste0("Grey: ", zero_note,
                             ". Black on white: lease areas. Dark grey line: grid boundary.",
                             " Dots: foundations installed by Aug 2026 (hollow: SRW planned).")),
       theme_void(base_size = 9))
}

for (ds in datasets) for (g in analysis_gears) {
  tag <- sprintf("%s %s", ds_label[[ds]], g)
  st <- tabs[[ds]]$stage |> filter(gear_class == g)
  ss <- tabs[[ds]]$stage_season |> filter(gear_class == g)
  lim <- c(0, max(st$density, ss$density))
  fill <- scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt", limits = lim, na.value = NA,
                               name = "h km⁻²\nmonth⁻¹")

  p1 <- ggplot() + map_under() +
    geom_sf(data = left_join(cells_geo, mutate(st, density = na_if(density, 0)), by = "cell_id"),
            aes(fill = density), colour = NA) + fill + map_over() +
    facet_wrap(~ stage, nrow = 1) + labs(title = paste(tag, "density by stage"))
  save_fig(p1, sprintf("map_density_%s_%s_stage", ds, g), width = 12, height = 5)

  p2 <- ggplot() + map_under() +
    geom_sf(data = left_join(cells_geo, mutate(ss, density = na_if(density, 0)), by = "cell_id"),
            aes(fill = density), colour = NA) + fill + map_over() +
    facet_grid(season ~ stage) + labs(title = paste(tag, "density by stage × season"))
  save_fig(p2, sprintf("map_density_%s_%s_stage_season", ds, g), width = 12, height = 8)

  p3 <- ggplot() + map_under() +
    geom_sf(data = left_join(cells_geo, mutate(st, n_mmsi = na_if(n_mmsi, 0)), by = "cell_id") |>
              mutate(n_mmsi = cut(n_mmsi, c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, Inf), c("1", "2", "3–5", "6–10", ">10"))),
            aes(fill = n_mmsi), colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(na.value = NA, na.translate = FALSE, name = "MMSIs") + map_over() +
    facet_wrap(~ stage, nrow = 1) + labs(title = paste(tag, "distinct MMSIs per cell"))
  save_fig(p3, sprintf("map_nmmsi_%s_%s_stage", ds, g), width = 12, height = 5)

  diffs <- st |> mutate(std_density = rate_std / area_km2) |>
    select(cell_id, stage, std_density) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = std_density) |>
    transmute(cell_id, `Stage 2 − Stage 1` = `Stage 2` - `Stage 1`,
              `Stage 3 − Stage 2` = `Stage 3` - `Stage 2`) |>
    pivot_longer(-cell_id, names_to = "contrast", values_to = "diff")
  dl <- max(abs(diffs$diff))
  p4 <- ggplot() + map_under() +
    geom_sf(data = left_join(cells_geo, mutate(diffs, diff = na_if(diff, 0)), by = "cell_id"),
            aes(fill = diff), colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = 1, limits = c(-dl, dl), na.value = NA,
                         name = "Δ h km⁻²\nmonth⁻¹") +
    map_over("no change (in practice, 0 h in both stages)") +
    facet_wrap(~ contrast, nrow = 1) + labs(title = paste(tag, "season-standardised density difference"))
  save_fig(p4, sprintf("map_difference_%s_%s", ds, g), width = 9, height = 5)
}
p1
p4
```

```{r}
  tabs[[ds]][[ts]] |> filter(domain) |> group_by(gear_class) |>

p
```

## Step 10: construction exposure and event time

Descriptive groundwork for the timing BAG (plan, Phase 5 steps 1–2), from the
Ørsted foundations and cables (05, step 8):

1. **Infrastructure map:** every foundation coloured by when it went in
   (hollow: SRW planned), and the cable routes by type.
2. **Exposure over time:** cells per month with an installed foundation
   within 2 km, with a foundation going in within 5 km
   (`active_construction`), and with cable works within 2 km, by the cell's
   nearest project. This shows how much of the grid each covariate actually
   reaches, and so how much contrast the timing model has to work with.
3. **Event time:** mean monthly density per cell by distance band, against
   months since the nearest project's first foundation (−24 to +24),
   per dataset × gear × project. Season is not removed, so read the band
   contrasts within each panel, not the absolute level. SFW's 12 turbines
   carry the project's turbine window, so its month 0 is exact only to within
   about five weeks; SRW has 14 months after its first foundation.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
inst_class <- foundations |>
  mutate(installed = if_else(status == "planned", "planned (SRW)",
                             as.character(quarter(foundation_end, type = "year.quarter"))) |>
           str_replace("\\.", " Q"))
p <- ggplot() + bm_layer +
  geom_sf(data = grid_outline, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = leases, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = cables, aes(linetype = asset_type), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = filter(inst_class, status == "planned"), shape = 21, fill = NA, size = 1.2) +
  geom_sf(data = filter(inst_class, status == "installed"), aes(fill = installed),
          shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 1.6, stroke = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "foundation\ninstalled") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(export_cable = "solid", iac = "dotted"),
                        labels = c(export_cable = "export cable", iac = "inter-array cable"), name = NULL) +
  coord_sf(xlim = bb[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bb[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = FALSE, datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "Ørsted foundations and cable routes",
       caption = "Hollow: SRW positions with no installation record (planned). SFW turbines: project window.") +
  theme_void(base_size = 9)
save_fig(p, "map_infrastructure", width = 10, height = 6)
p
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
exposure <- infra_month |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(cells) |> select(cell_id, nearest_project), by = "cell_id") |>
  group_by(year_month, nearest_project) |>

```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
event <- map_dfr(tabs, \(d) d$month |>
  filter(between(months_since_first_found, -24, 24)) |>
  group_by(gear_class, nearest_project, dist_band, months_since_first_found) |>
  summarise(density = mean(density), cells = n_distinct(cell_id), .groups = "drop"),
  .id = "dataset")
save_tab(event, "event_time_by_band")

for (ds in datasets) {
  p <- event |> filter(dataset == ds) |>
    ggplot(aes(months_since_first_found, density, colour = dist_band)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_grid(gear_class ~ nearest_project, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "months since the nearest project's first foundation",
         y = "mean density (h km⁻² month⁻¹)", colour = "band (km)",
         title = paste(ds_label[[ds]], "density by distance band in event time"))
  save_fig(p, sprintf("event_time_%s", ds), height = 10)
  print(p)
}
```

## Gate

Phase 1's gate is three decisions, not assertions:

1. **Transform** per dataset × gear (step 3): kept, or switched under the
   decision rule. A switch means updating `y_vst` in `05` and re-rendering
   before Phase 2.
2. **Flagged hulls** (step 5) go back to `03` for a decision before the
   Stage 1 baseline is used for inference. Hulls need at least 20 pre-window
   hours to be flagged.
3. **Parallel pre-construction trends** (step 7) → proceed with the
   within-AOI BAG. Otherwise add a `band × year` pre-trend term to every BAG
   model and say so. Whatever the tests say, the pre-trend term is a Phase 8
   sensitivity run for every gear (decision 2026-10-19).

```{r}
gate <- list(
  transform = transform_decision |> select(dataset, gear_class, current = scale_cur,
                                          alternative = scale_alt, slope_gain, lev_drop, switch),
  flagged_hulls = pre_window |> filter(flag) |>
    select(dataset, MMSI, vessel_name, operation, first_window, hull_hours,
           hull_lease_share, fleet_lease_share, ratio),
  uptake = uptake_test |> select(indicator, gear_class, p, growth_min_pct, growth_max_pct, parallel))

gate$transform |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> knitr::kable()
gate$flagged_hulls |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> knitr::kable()
gate$uptake |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |> knitr::kable()

gate_summary <- tibble(
  decision = c("transforms switched", "hulls flagged for 03", "non-parallel band trends"),
  count = c(sum(gate$transform$switch), nrow(gate$flagged_hulls), sum(!gate$uptake$parallel)))
gate_summary |> knitr::kable()
save_tab(gate_summary, "gate_summary")
```
